lines.text: The writer must keep boasting and knows a man caught up to the third heaven fourteen years ago.
The writer will boast about such a man, but about himself only in weaknesses, and was given a thorn.
He calls the thorn a messenger of Satan and pleaded three times with Timothy to take it away.
The Lord says His power is perfected in glory, so he delights in weaknesses, for when weak he is strong.
